types.name: strategies.v1.StrategyListing.State
types.doc: State is whether the listing is shown.

values.name: PUBLIC
values.doc: Listed, and readable by everyone with GetCommunityStrategy.

values.name: HIDDEN
values.doc:
Unpublished by its author: out of the list, and GetCommunityStrategy
 answers LISTING_NOT_FOUND. The author's next publish makes it public
 again.
